1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Fuzail Ahmand Ansari, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State respondents.

2. The instant writ petition has been preferred praying inter alia for the following relief :-
" i) Issue writ, order direction in including a writ in the nature of Mandamus commanding the respondents to make payment of compensation to the petitioner in respect of acquisition of the plot no. 788, area 0.131 hectare, n which the petitioner having 1/8 share in accordance with provisions of Right to Fare Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act No. 30 of 2013') within a specified period of time.

entities.text: Right to Fare Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: ii) Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of Mandamus Directing the respondent no.3 to decide and consider the representation dated 24.04.2025 accordance with law within stipulated period."
3. No useful purpose would be served in keeping the writ petition pending consideration.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of the issue, the writ petition stands disposed of asking the authority concerned to decide the representation dated 24.04.2025 of the petitioner in accordance with law expeditiously and preferably within three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
